physical_manifest.scope: One fixed-RTL physical implementation; historical records are unchanged

proposal_rationale: Only context/baseline.json is available; reports/ contains no evaluation history. The qualified baseline (40, 0.55, 0, 0) has cell area 161954 um2, setup slack 0.19292 ns, hold slack 0.114491 ns, zero reported electrical violations, and score 1.0. Its DOT64/GEMM8/CONV3 energies are 2.293945631906608e-7/1.7792685987008622e-6/1.1542462882162743e-6 J. Choose the previously untried in-domain tuple (40, 0.55, 1, 0), changing only the area-oriented ABC option to target the cell-area factor and potentially mapped-cell energy in the frozen area-times-geometric-mean-energy objective. Keeping the baseline placement parameters and repair margin isolates this change. The small positive setup margin makes timing regression a material risk; area reduction, energy reduction, physical qualification, and a lower score are hypotheses requiring independent evaluation. Baseline energy uses Liberty estimates from zero-delay post-route activity and SPEF, not silicon or glitch-inclusive measurements. RTL, clock, libraries, and acceptance thresholds remain frozen.
